name: Reviewbird
description:
Manage your WooCommerce product reviews from Claude.  Draft and publish replies, moderate new reviews, or use a sentiment analysis to understand what customers are saying about your products.

Example prompts:

- Compare the last 30 days with the previous 30 days. Show changes in review count, average rating, and reply rate.
- Which products have the most one-star and two-star reviews? Summarize the main issue for each.
- Show pending and flagged reviews that need a decision.
- Find recent approved reviews without a public reply and draft a reply for each one.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Reviewbird to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Reviewbird to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.reviewbird.com/mcp/reviewbird. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Reviewbird MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reviewbird provides these MCP tools: approve_review, create_public_reply, get_review, get_review_content, get_review_metrics, list_stores, read_reviews, reject_review, search_products, and search_reviews.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Reviewbird?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Reviewbird in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Reviewbird requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Reviewbird is developed by Reviewbird. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
